about: Behaviour and control requirements Shawn stated for the flight pack, in his words. Hardware geometry facts live in cad/DESIGN-CONTRACT.json; part status in ../../CURRENT-STATE.json (parts_flight_pack). Add a requirement here in the turn he states it. Each requirement carries a coverage object tying it to gate cells and training conditions; python3 requirements_check.py must pass before a training launch.

requirements.words: 所以遥控器上可能最初就要有一个开关，是喷气背包模式还是普通模式。这个应该可能最开始就要区分。
requirements.meaning: The remote (robot-live page) has a switch chosen at the start: jetpack mode or normal mode. The choice is made before the brain starts moving the robot, not switched mid-run.
requirements.why: The with-pack policy (train/out/results.json, fq2 1999) falls 5 of 20 walking without the pack, and the old policies fall 279 of 280 with it; the runtime's open-loop stand mode falls in 0.54 s with the pack, so with the pack the policy must take over from the first tick.
what_the_mode_selects: policy pair: with-pack stand/walk policy versus the current stand61/walk61
start-up flow: with the pack, no open-loop stand; the policy runs from the first tick
whether flight controls (arm, take off, land, stop fans) are shown and enabled
requirements.acceptance: Starting in each mode loads that mode's policies and start-up flow, shown on the page; a start with the pack fitted in normal mode, or without it in jetpack mode, is refused or warned before torque comes on.
requirements.status: recorded, not implemented; the with-pack policy exists in simulation only and nothing is deployed to the robot
requirements.open: resolved by FP-R2: the mode is detected, not chosen by hand

coverage.not_applicable: Mode switch on the remote is the fallback if the universal policy fails; it is runtime UI, not a training condition.

requirements.words: 等等，这个其实是A7Z是可以探测到的，对吧？A7Z探测到有背包，那就用背包模式。根本就不用手切，对吗？
requirements.meaning: The A7Z detects the pack and selects jetpack mode by itself; no manual switch in normal use. This replaces the hand-chosen switch of FP-R1; what the mode selects stays as in FP-R1.
requirements.mechanism_planned: The flight controller sends a MAVLink heartbeat about once a second on FC UART1 to A7Z pins 16/18 (wiring/wiring.json). Heartbeat seen before torque comes on = jetpack mode; none = normal mode. The page shows the detected mode before torque.
requirements.known_gap: The flight controller is powered only from the flight batteries. Pack fitted but its batteries unplugged gives no heartbeat, so detection alone would pick normal mode with about 1 kg on the back. Needs one of: a detection that works unpowered, or the page showing the detected mode with a manual override as the fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Brain started with the pack powered loads the with-pack policies with no user action and shows 'jetpack mode' on the page; started without the pack shows 'normal mode'; the unpowered-pack case is either detected or visibly flagged before torque.
requirements.status: recorded, not implemented; the A7Z spare serial port has not been enabled or tested yet

coverage.not_applicable: Pack detection by the A7Z is runtime code and the fallback route; not a training condition.

requirements.words: 或者能不能训练一个能通用的走路和支撑模型？就像人扛着一个重物和不扛重物都能适应，都能适应着走 ... 负重为0或者1公斤在背上都能走，是不是这样会好一点？ / 可以的，对，尽量按照通用模型来试吧。
requirements.meaning: Prefer one universal stand/walk policy that works with any back load from 0 to about 1 kg, so that walking does not depend on mode selection (FP-R1, FP-R2 stay as the fallback and for showing flight controls).
requirements.acceptance: In the existing probe the universal policy is not worse than the with-pack specialist (fq2 1999) with the pack, not worse than stand61/walk61 without it, and holds at intermediate loads; otherwise two policy sets plus detection remain.
requirements.status: plan requested (train/UNIVERSAL-PLAN.md); no training launched; Shawn sees the plan before any run

requirements.words: 这样省得我们一直拿下来再插回去，对吧？我们尽量希望它安装以后就一直装在上面。
requirements.meaning: Once fitted, the pack stays on the duck; it is not taken off and refitted between uses. Walking, turning, bending and head motion must work with the pack on as the normal state.
consequences: the with-pack case is the main case for the policy; the no-pack and part-load cases (flight batteries out for charging) are secondary but must not fall
the flight batteries must be chargeable or swappable without removing the pack
leg servos carry about twice the load all the time: heat and wear under continuous walking are unmeasured

coverage.not_applicable: The pack staying mounted is a hardware and usage requirement; its training consequence is FP-R3 and FP-R8.

requirements.words: 训练完成以后走路怎么有点外八 有点难看啊。。。 另外弯腰那些还能做吗 头部运动那些
requirements.meaning: With the pack the walk must not look splayed (toes out) compared with the gait he knows; bending for the pickup and head motion must still work with the pack on.
requirements.acceptance: Stance foot heading and step width of the with-pack walk measured against walk61 without the pack and held near it; the pickup bend and the runtime's head pitch/yaw motions run with the pack in the probe without falls and inside the joint torque limit.
requirements.status: measured in simulation 2026-11-11 (train/out/style_bend_head.json). Toe-out: fq2 1999 with the pack 21.3 / 22.2 deg stance foot yaw and 119 mm step width against walk61's 7.3 / 4.2 deg and 94 mm: NOT met; a foot-heading term is in train/UNIVERSAL-PLAN.md, whose incentive audit does not pass yet. Head motion standing and walking: 0 falls (quack not yet exercised). Bend with the pack: 20 of 20 fall, hip pitch at the torque limit: NOT met; the bend is a separate policy, plan requested (train/BEND-PLAN.md). Geometry clears (cad/checks/accepted.json). No training launched

requirements.meaning: With-pack simulation views and videos show the pack itself (CAD meshes at the CAD pose), not only its mass.
requirements.acceptance: Walk, landing and flight clips show the pack on the duck; visual geoms only, existing probe numbers unchanged.

requirements.words: 捡不起东西了 不能接受
requirements.meaning: The bend exists to pick an item up with the beak (final goal step 4). A bend policy that stays upright but cannot pick the item up is rejected, whatever its posture and torque numbers. Said about bend4 (knee about 1.17 rad, trunk pitch about 28 deg) after its clip.
requirements.acceptance: A pickup test in the runtime simulation with the 12 mm ball: the item is in the beak after the rise and still held after the hand-back to the stand policy, counted per load (full pack, batteries out, no pack), compared with the original pick policy without the pack. Mouth height, trunk pitch and torque lines stay as supporting lines; they cannot pass a bend by themselves.

requirements.words: 背包装了以后，它喷气的时候不负重，不是还是会减到0吗？到时候背包喷气一喷，你又不会走路了？ / 2026-11-20 later: 而且负载不仅会到0，还会把自己的体重减轻。
requirements.meaning: The load on the legs changes inside one run. Fan thrust first cancels the pack's weight and then carries the robot's own weight too: the legs go from pack plus body, through body alone, down to nothing at lift-off, and back at landing. The universal stand/walk policy (FP-R3) must stay up through that whole range while it changes, by feeling it; a constant pack-fitted input is not a solution.
requirements.acceptance: Gate cells with fan thrust on the pack: constant thrust at fractions of whole-robot weight from 0 to just under 1, a ramp up and back while standing and while walking, and a take-off ramp to lift-off and a landing ramp back while standing; falls 0 and jumps within the existing stand/walk lines. Training must contain within-episode thrust changes over the same range.
requirements.status: NOT met 2026-11-20: neither the training env (payload.py: one payload class per episode, constant) nor ts3_gates.py contains any thrust. Found only when Shawn pointed it out. Measurement of existing teacher/student under thrust started on the Mac mini; env and gate change follow.
